Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 21 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. A 254 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital.
